desc: Build children adjacency list (0-indexed) and indegree array.
Find cycle nodes by removing nodes with indegree 0 in a queue.
Iterative DFS from cycle nodes to produce a global post-order of non-cycle nodes.
For each node in post-order, compute dp[u][k] = product over children c of (sum_{t=k}^{M} dp[c][t]) mod MOD, using prefix sums.
Group cycle nodes into disjoint cycles and compute component total = sum_{k=1}^{M} prod(dp[r][k] for r in cycle) mod MOD.
Multiply component totals modulo 998244353 and output the answer.
